description.narrative: The intervention aims to reinforce protection for refugees and asylum seekers in the priority provinces of Ar and Van by enabling UNHCR to support HRDFs established field activities and to channel small scale grants to refugee led and civil society organizations through a dedicated call for proposals. By combining direct assistance with system strengthening measures, the initiative bolsters local capacity and continuity at a time of shrinking humanitarian resources. The targeted support focuses on reaching the most vulnerable groups - including survivors of gender based violence, at risk children, and persons with disabilities or other specific needs - while empowering locally rooted actors to deliver legal aid, case management, psychosocial support, and community based services that enhance access to national protection systems and promote long term resilience.
